author: niktek
text:
Grand Theft Auto VI may launch on PC sooner than we expected

GamesBeat has confirmed that GTA 6 is set for a PC launch in Q1 of 2027, according to four industry sources familiar with the studio’s plans.

This release schedule is much more different compared to previous Rockstar PC port releases which have sometimes taken well over a year.

GamesBeat has contacted a Rockstar Games representative prior to publishing this article but they did not respond to a request for comment.

Source: https://gamesbeat.com/grand-theft-auto-vis-pc-release-is-slated-for-q1-2027/

author: gta6plus
text:
In GTA 6, a new haircut won't fool the cops if you're still wearing the outfit they saw.

Rockstar's Rob Nelson explained the escape options in IGN's full interview:

- Keep spare outfits in your car's trunk so you can change out of clothes the cops recognize.
- Split Jason and Lucia up. Police can recognize them as a couple, so separating helps.
- Switch cars to make it harder for the cops to recognize you.
- With three stars in the city, escaping on foot through alleys can be a better option than staying in a car.
- Some stolen cars have trackers that ping the cops when you drive too slowly.
